items.title: File objection (Widerspruch) against rejection of rehabilitation application
items.quote: Erheben Sie ihn binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Muster-Rentenversicherung Nordwest.
items.computation: Letter dated 2025-03-11 (Tuesday); assumed posted that day. Under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X a posted decision counts as delivered on the third day after posting: 2025-03-14 (Friday). Period of one month (§ 84 SGG, §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB) starts the day after delivery (15.03.) and ends on the same-numbered day of the next month: 2025-04-14. This is a Monday, not a holiday in NRW (Easter Monday is 21.04.2025), so no shift.
